name: WNYC & NYC Municipal Archives Audio Collection
operator: New York Public Radio (NYPR) & NYC Department of Records

pricing.billingNote: Public radio archival preservation funded by NEH, CPB, and listener support.

provenance.primaryMasterSource: Original WNYC Municipal Broadcasting System 16" lacquer discs and ¼-inch master tapes
provenance.airdateMethodology: WNYC master broadcast logs, Master Control sheets, and *New York Times* / *Brooklyn Daily Eagle* radio listings
provenance.castAttributionMethod: Archivist-curated speaker, musician, and commentator records

specNotes.lossless_et: High-grade municipal lacquer transfers, but scope is limited to NYC civic/musical broadcasts (~1,850 items).

primary_source_verification.summary: Verified by NYPR professional archivists against WNYC studio logs, lacquer labels, and NYC newspapers.
primary_source_verification.evidenceQuote: "Cataloged by NYPR Archives staff directly from original 16-inch lacquer labels and WNYC Master Control logs."

cast_credit_accuracy.summary: Accurate speaker, interviewer, composer, and performer attribution on every archival post.
cast_credit_accuracy.evidenceQuote: "Detailed archivist essays and speaker credits accompany digitized lacquer transfers."

vtt_transcripts.summary: Transcripts available on select AAPB-partnered items, but not universal `.vtt` synchronized captions across all 8,500 recordings.
vtt_transcripts.evidenceQuote: "Select broadcasts include text transcripts via American Archive of Public Broadcasting partnerships."

master_provenance.summary: Digitized at 24-bit/96kHz directly from WNYC's surviving 16-inch aluminum and glass-base lacquer discs.
master_provenance.evidenceQuote: "Preserved from over 50,000 lacquer discs discovered in the NYC Municipal Archives and WNYC vaults."

serial_continuity.summary: Chronological series collections for recurring municipal and cultural programs.
serial_continuity.evidenceQuote: "Organized by program series and chronological broadcast date."

open_api_export.summary: Embeddable audio player, RSS feeds, and AAPB metadata records.
open_api_export.evidenceQuote: "Public RSS feeds and American Archive of Public Broadcasting (AAPB) PBCore XML records."

ad_free_playback.summary: Free public streaming without commercial ad breaks.
ad_free_playback.evidenceQuote: "Streamed free to the public as part of NYPR's public service mission."

dedup_integrity.summary: Unique municipal lacquer disc numbers and NYPR catalog IDs.
dedup_integrity.evidenceQuote: "Each lacquer side is cataloged under a unique Municipal Archives / NYPR preservation identifier."

gotchas.title: Scoped to WNYC / NYC Municipal Broadcasts Only
gotchas.detail: Does not host commercial network entertainment series (*Jack Benny*, *Suspense*, *Lux Radio Theatre*) unless they intersected with WNYC.
